title: The Reasoning Bottleneck in Graph-RAG: Structured Prompting and Context Compression for Multi-Hop QA
abstract: arXiv:2603.14045v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Graph-RAG systems achieve strong multi-hop question answering by indexing documents into knowledge graphs, but strong retrieval does not guarantee strong answers. Evaluating KET-RAG, a leading Graph-RAG system, on three multi-hop QA benchmarks (HotpotQA, MuSiQue, 2WikiMultiHopQA), we find that 77% to 91% of questions have the gold answer in the retrieved context, yet accuracy is only 35% to 78%, and 73% to 84% of errors are reasoning failures. We propose two augmentations: (i) SPARQL chain-of-thought prompting, which decomposes questions into triple-pattern queries aligned with the entity-relationship context, and (ii) graph-walk compression, which compresses the context by ~60% via knowledge-graph traversal with no LLM calls. SPARQL CoT improves accuracy by +2 to +14 pp; graph-walk compression adds +6 pp on average when paired with structured prompting on smaller models. translated_title: Graph-RAG 中的推理瓶颈：面向多跳问答的结构化提示与上下文压缩
translated_abstract: Graph-RAG 系统通过将文档索引到知识图谱中来实现强大的多跳问答能力，但强大的检索并不保证能产生正确的答案。我们在三个多跳问答基准（HotpotQA、MuSiQue、2WikiMultiHopQA）上评估了领先的 Graph-RAG 系统 KET-RAG，发现 77% 至 91% 的问题在检索到的上下文中已包含标准答案，但准确率仅为 35% 至 78%，且 73% 至 84% 的错误源于推理失败。我们提出了两项增强方法：（i）SPARQL 思维链提示，将问题分解为与实体-关系上下文对齐的三元组模式查询；（ii）图游走压缩，通过知识图谱遍历将上下文压缩约 60%，且无需任何大语言模型调用。SPARQL 思维链提示将准确率提升了 2 至 14 个百分点；在较小模型上与结构化提示配合使用时，图游走压缩平均可额外带来 6 个百分点的提升。令人惊讶的是，我们发现通过问题类型路由，……
tldr: 该论文发现 Graph-RAG 的真正瓶颈在于推理而非检索，并提出 SPARQL 思维链提示与免 LLM 调用的图游走上下文压缩两项方法，显著提升多跳问答准确率并将上下文压缩约 60%。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that the bottleneck of Graph-RAG lies in reasoning rather than retrieval, and proposes SPARQL chain-of-thought prompting and LLM-free graph-walk context compression, boosting multi-hop QA accuracy while compressing context by about 60%.
